column1: # clues.tsv for ex01 (the Makefile) — pedagogic hints only. NEVER state the expected value or the fix.
# The build test prints its own reasons; these are the questions behind them.
Where does the subject say the sources and the header live, and where must libft.a end up? Your Makefile runs from the exercise directory: every path in it is relative to that.
Which files may your Makefile compile? The subject names five and ends with "Watch out for wildcards!": what would a pattern matching every .c in srcs/ pick up in a directory you have never seen?
What should a second `make`, right after the first, have left to do? And when a single source changes, how many objects does make have to rebuild, and how does it know which?
What exactly does each of clean, fclean and re promise to leave behind? And what should the second of two runs in a row do?
